brand_identity.name: RapidFix
brand_identity.persona: The reliable, high-tech Puerto Rican neighbor who fixes it right the first time.
brand_identity.language_strategy: Spanish-First (ES/EN toggle required). Copy should be warm but professional.

display.usage: Main Headings (H1, H2), Hero Text, CTA Buttons

colors.gradients: NO PURPLE. Use subtle linear gradients between Ocean and Storm only for depth. e.g., bg-gradient-to-b from-storm to-ocean.

textures.name: Noise Overlay
textures.css: background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E"); pointer-events: none; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 50; mix-blend-mode: overlay;

motifs: SVG Pipes: Use clean, geometric pipe lines as background dividers.
Water Ripples: CSS-only animation in the Hero section (blue circles expanding/fading).
Tropical Shadows: Use hard shadows (no blur) or deep diffuse shadows to simulate tropical sun.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Rectangular, sharp edges for 'Industrial' feel. Minimal border-radius (max 4px or 0px).

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-24. Mobile needs p-4 min.
layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento Grid for Services. Asymmetric styling.

mobile_first.sticky_bar: Fixed bottom bar with 'Call Now' (Flame) and 'WhatsApp' (Green/Ocean) buttons.

buttons.primary: bg-flame text-white font-bebas text-xl tracking-wide px-8 py-3 hover:bg-orange-600 sharp-corners shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(13,59,79,1)] hover:shadow-none hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] transition-all
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-ocean text-ocean font-bebas text-xl px-8 py-3 hover:bg-ocean hover:text-white transition-colors

cards.service_card: bg-white border-l-4 border-flame p-6 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-shadow. No border-radius.
cards.review_card: bg-cement p-6 font-serif italic text-storm relative. Add quote icon.

hero.style: Full viewport height (min-h-[90vh]). Background: Ocean/Storm gradient. Foreground: Animated CSS Water Ripples. Content: Center aligned, huge text.
hero.animation: CSS Ripple effect behind the main headline.

emergency_banner.style: bg-flame text-white font-bebas text-2xl p-4 flex justify-between items-center. Use 'Industrial Stripes' texture overlay.

svg_strategies.pipes: Use simple SVG paths (stroke-width: 2) to connect sections visually. Color: #0D3B4F with low opacity (0.2).
svg_strategies.icons: Use Lucide-React or Heroicons. Stroke width: 2px. Sharp edges preferred.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Install fonts via Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Set up Tailwind colors in tailwind.config.js as per the palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Create the 'Noise Overlay' as a global component in App.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build the 'Sticky Bottom CTA' component for mobile view (hidden on desktop).
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement the Hero with CSS-only water ripple animation (no images).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use 'Bebas Neue' for all Headings. 'DM Sans' for body. 'Instrument Serif' for quotes/accents.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Ensure all text has high contrast. Ocean background needs White text.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: NO STOCK PHOTOS. Use the colors, typography, and CSS textures to carry the visual weight.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Create a bilingual toggle state (simple boolean context) that switches text content.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures separates good from extraordinary.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
